svg.title: AWS: dedicated delivery and shared SQL ingress
svg.desc: PostgreSQL outcomes and durable owner events share a transaction. Event-relay accesses the ledger through RDS Proxy, publishes to fixed independent ElastiCache for Valkey shards, and a dedicated Fargate raw ASGI gateway replays with a read-only database role. ALB routes SSE separately from targeted Django API reads.

g.text: Dedicated raw ASGI gateway on ECS/Fargate
Read-only replay; bounded shared DB pool
Session + owner checks; global socket leases
ElastiCache for Valkey: private TLS primaries
Missed wakes recover from durable replay
One EventSource per visible authenticated tab
Change IDs coalesce targeted REST reads
Render saved result and durable inbox
Gateway SQL uses resume_stream; ordinary transactions use resume_app; nonlogin ownership stays in bootstrap.
AWS: dedicated delivery and shared SQL ingress
Terraform-defined · exact ALB SSE route · small configurable service counts
Heartbeat keeps the ALB connection active. Shard-map changes require a coordinated gateway drain and ledger replay.
